subject: SIG/CAIQ dry-run & ISO scope orchestration — proposed plan
messages:
From: Jordan Klein <jordan.klein@acme.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Cc: audits@thirdparty-audit.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake and ISO scope question

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the initial SIG/CAIQ draft. Before we move into the formal audit window, our audit team has asked for a short internal dry run focused on: control owner confirmation, evidence accessibility (S3/Drive paths), and sampling windows for logs/retention.

Can Redwood run a 2-hour dry run week of May 24 to verify:
- control-owner contact list is accurate
- attachments & evidence map open and downloadable without escalation
- CAIQ entries that we flagged as "partial" are clarified

I attached an annotated intake spreadsheet with a few sample asks (see referenced attachment).

Jordan
Jordan Klein
CISO, Acme Corp

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Jordan Klein <jordan.klein@acme.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, audits@thirdparty-audit.com
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake and ISO scope question — proposed dry-run plan

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear asks. We can run a focused dry run on Tue, May 25 at 14:00 PT (2 hrs). Proposed agenda:
1) Quick intro & goals (10m)
2) Walk through SIG/CAIQ items flagged as partial (30m)
3) Evidence access test (download + verify checksums) (40m)
4) Control-owner confirmations (roles & fallback contacts) (20m)
5) Action items & timeline (20m)

Immediate asks for us before the session:
- Please confirm sample user and S3 path we should use for evidence pull.
- Any additional CAIQ rows you want prioritized, add a column in the attached spreadsheet.

I've attached our current SIG/CAIQ responses export and an evidence inventory snapshot. Ben will lead the evidence access step; Olga will own control-owner confirmations. Jordan B. will capture action items and zips for auditor submission.

If that slot works, we'll send a calendar invite and the dry-run checklist.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

[Attachments: SIG-CAIQ-responses-v0.9.xlsx (xlsx), evidence_inventory.csv (csv), dryrun-checklist-2027-05.docx (docx)]

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake and ISO scope question — evidence access note

Quick note ahead of the dry run:
- Evidence buckets are in the us-west-2 account; access uses temporary presigned URLs we generate during a session to avoid broad permission changes.
- For the dry run we'll stage a small set (~20 files) including configuration snapshots, KMS key metadata export, and a sample log archive for retention verification.
- If the auditor needs continuous direct S3 access later, we'll propose a limited role with MFA and time-bound assumptions.

Ben Carter
Security Ops
Redwood Inference

P.S. Olga — can you please confirm the list of control owners for SOC 2 / ISO controls by EOD Fri (21 May)? I'll start composing the evidence pull scripts after that.

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ intake and ISO scope question — control owners and sampling windows

Ben / Tessa —

I've attached the control-owner roster (column: primary, secondary, escalation). A couple of notable gaps:
- Control ISO-A.4.2 (third-party vendor onboarding) still needs a secondary owner from Vendor Ops (we've requested Nora to step in; pending).
- Log sampling windows: our default retention extracts are 90/180/365 days depending on control; auditors asked for 30-day chronological samples — I'll prepare 30-day zips for the dry run.

We'll flag the CAIQ rows where evidence is "archived" vs "live" so the auditor knows which items must be pulled vs accepted by attestation.

Olga Petrov
